```{r}
#| echo: false
# DO NOT EDIT THIS CHUNK #
library(tidyverse)
library(ssstats)
# problem 1
set.seed(1996)
tours96 <- tibble(band_id = paste0("B", 1:200),
                  label_type = sample(c("Major", "Indie"), 
                                      size = 200, 
                                      replace = TRUE, 
                                      prob = c(0.6, 0.4))) %>%
  mutate(toured = case_when(label_type == "Major" ~ rbinom(n(), 1, 0.85),
                            label_type == "Indie" ~ rbinom(n(), 1, 0.60)),
         toured = if_else(toured == 1, "Yes", "No"))



# problem 2
set.seed(1996)
regions96 <- tibble(band_id = paste0("B", 1:200),
                  label_type = sample(c("Major", "Indie"), 
                                      size = 200, 
                                      replace = TRUE, 
                                      prob = c(0.6, 0.4)),
                  toured = case_when(label_type == "Major" ~ rbinom(200, 1, 0.85),
                                     label_type == "Indie" ~ rbinom(200, 1, 0.60)),
                  region = case_when(label_type == "Major" ~ sample(c("West", "Midwest", "South", "Northeast"),
                                                                    size = 200, 
                                                                    replace = TRUE,
                                                                    prob = c(0.25, 0.25, 0.30, 0.20)),
                                     label_type == "Indie" ~ sample(c("West", "Midwest", "South", "Northeast"),
                                                                    size = 200, 
                                                                    replace = TRUE,
                                                                    prob = c(0.35, 0.20, 0.15, 0.30)))) %>%
  filter(toured == 1) %>%  
  select(band_id, label_type, region)

# problem 3
indie96 <- regions96 %>% filter(label_type == "Indie")

# problem 4

set.seed(2001)
respondents <- tibble(respondent_id = paste0("R", 1:200),
                      upset = c(rep("Yes", 54), rep("No", 200 - 54))) %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 1)  # shuffle the order
```
